en.title: Notice on Special Lecture Replacing English Graduation Certification for Graduation Candidates in February 2027
summary: Special lecture replacing English graduation certification for graduation candidates in February 2027 (including completion status students (수료자)).

Eligibility: Students who have a record of submitting an official English score report that does not meet the requirement to their department office by the application deadline (students without submission records cannot apply).

How to Apply: Log in to Inha Portal System -> Academic Affairs (학적) -> Academic Internet Application (학적인터넷신청) -> [Application Type] TOEIC Special Lecture for Graduation Certification (졸업인증토익특강) -> Select preferred class (Morning/Afternoon) -> Save.
Lecture Period & Tuition: Dec 28, 2026 ~ Jan 08, 2027; Tuition is free (textbook must be purchased separately).
en.easyExplanation: This is a notice regarding a free special lecture replacing English graduation certification for candidates for graduation assessment in February 2027 (including completion status students (수료자)). Only students who have a submission record of an official English test score below the qualification criteria at their department office can apply via the Inha Portal System between December 21, 2026, 09:00 and December 22, 2026, 16:00.
en.target: Candidates for graduation assessment in February 2027 (including completion status students (수료자)). Note: A submission record of an official English score report (TOEIC (Speaking), New TEPS, OPIC, etc.) that falls below the qualification criteria to the department office by the application deadline is mandatory; students without a submission record cannot apply.
en.eventInfo: Online non-real-time special lecture replacing English graduation certification

단, 신청종료일까지 자격기준에 미달되는 공인영어성적표(토익(스피킹), New TEPS, OPIC 등) 제출기록 필수(제출할 곳: 학과사무실); 제출기록이 없는 학생 신청불가
3. 신청방법: 인하포털시스템 로그인→ 학적→ 학적인터넷신청→
[신청종류] 졸업인증토익특강→ 수강희망반 선택(오전반/오후반)→ [저장]
4. 반 배정결과 및 유의사항
가. 반 배정결과(오전반 또는 오후반) 학교 홈페이지 안내: 2026.12.24.(목) 15:00∼
나. 유의사항
(1) 수강인원이 편중(오전 또는 오후)되면 신청순서에 따라 임의로 분반배정 예정
(2) 평가결과(출석, 과제, 시험성적 등)에 따라 영어졸업인증 취득여부 판정
다. 인하졸업인증제 안내: 학교홈페이지→학사→졸업/증명서발급→인하졸업인증
5. 문의처: 소속학과 사무실, 학사관리팀 (전화번호: 교내 9319, Email: hanna@inha.ac.kr)
